AtomForge Icons (AtomForgeIcons.h) is a subset of the Codicons icon font.

Codicons
Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons

The Codicons font is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
International License (CC BY 4.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Changes: only the glyphs used by the AtomForge interface are kept (see
make_icon_font.py), hinting is removed, and the font is renamed
"AtomForge Icons". The glyph designs are unchanged.
